function.name: get_compound
function.description: Look up a small-molecule record by PubChem CID (e.g. 2244). Returns cid, name, iupac_name, formula, smiles, molecular_weight (Da), heavy_atom_count and h_bond_donors.

function.name: find_compound_by_name
function.description: Look up a small-molecule record by its common name (e.g. aspirin). Returns the same fields as get_compound.
